def search_all_venmo_users(query):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while True:

        if not page:

        out.extend(page)

resolved = []
unresolved = []
ambiguities = []

for c in coworkers:
    c_email = (c.get('email') or '').lower()
    c_first = (c.get('first_name') or '').strip()
    c_last = (c.get('last_name') or '').strip()

    # 1) Try email search
    candidates = []
    if c_email:
        users = search_all_venmo_users(query=c_email)
        candidates = [u for u in users if (u.get('email') or '').lower() == c_email]
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            u = candidates[0]
            resolved.append((c_first, c_last, c_email, u.get('email'), u.get('first_name'), u.get('last_name')))
            continue
        elif len(candidates) > 1:
            ambiguities.append(('email', f"{c_first} {c_last} ({c_email})", candidates))
            continue

    # 2) Fallback to name search (exact first+last match post-filter)
    if c_first and c_last:
        users = search_all_venmo_users(query=f"{c_first} {c_last}")
        name_matches = [u for u in users if u.get('first_name','').lower()==c_first.lower() and u.get('last_name','').lower()==c_last.lower()]

            resolved.append((c_first, c_last, c_email, u.get('email'), u.get('first_name'), u.get('last_name')))
        elif len(name_matches) > 1:
            ambiguities.append(('name', f"{c_first} {c_last}", name_matches))
        else:
            unresolved.append((c_first, c_last, c_email))
    else:
        unresolved.append((c_first, c_last, c_email))
